The grievance of the appellant is with regard to the order dated 15 . 09 . 2014 passed by the High Court of Cal cut ta in CR R No . 26 82 / 2014 . 3 . The appellant had sent his resignation as Director of a Company called Z yl og Systems Limited on 24 . 06 . 2013 . This was followed by Form 32 sent by the company to the Registrar of Companies on 27 . 09 . 2013 . Form 32 clearly mentions that the appellant is no longer associated with the company from 24 . 06 . 2013 . It therefore appears that his resignation was accepted from that date . 4 . In the meanwhile , on 15 . 09 . 2013 , certain che ques were issued by the company and those che ques bounced . 5 . On the basis of these broad facts , the respondent preferred a complaint against the company and its Directors including the appellant under Section 138 / 141 of the Neg ot iable Instruments Act . 6 . The appellant sought qu ashing of the proceedings by approaching the Cal cut ta High Court . The High Court vide order dated 15 . 09 . 2014 dismissed the petition filed by the appellant . 7 . Against the dismissal order passed by the High Court , the appellant is now before us .

___8 . On per usal of the records , it is clear that the appellant had sent his resignation as a Director of the Company on 24 . 06 . 2013 and that was accepted perhaps on the very same date but in any case as disclosed in Form No . 32 , the appellant was no longer associated with the affairs of the company with effect from 24 . 06 . 2013 . 9 . The fact that certain che ques were issued by the company subsequent to the resignation of the appellant on 15 . 09 . 2013 cannot fo ist any criminal liability on the appellant only because those che ques have bounced . Under these circumstances , the appellant , not being associated with the affairs of the company , cannot be held liable for the acts of the company which have resulted in a complaint being filed by the respondent .
